candidate_selection.fit_use: Compute diagnostics and eliminate formula defects; no final selection from fit PnL alone.
candidate_selection.if_no_development_survivor: Stop. Do not open the two frozen validation dates or any 2024+ data.
candidate_selection.primary_choice: Among gate survivors maximize the minimum of 24bp mean return and 12bp top-10%-removed mean return; ties prefer more trades, shorter leader horizon, lower z threshold, then lexical candidate id.

economic_mechanism: The most liquid leader can incorporate market-wide information before a less dominant follower at sub-minute horizons.
Trade only when BTC price and aggressive flow agree, BTC activity is abnormal, and ETH has incorporated materially less than its prior-only beta-implied response.
A naive unconditional lead-lag rule is not accepted; the entry requires a measurable residual gap large enough to clear cost stress.

event_definition.event_cooldown: No new candidate from the same leader impulse until BTC displacement falls below 25% of the detected shock.

execution_and_exit.impulse_decay_exit: Exit when BTC signed displacement from shock start is <=25% of entry displacement for ten consecutive 100ms states.
execution_and_exit.opposite_shock_exit: Exit on a completed opposite BTC 1s shock with absolute prior-scaled z >=3.
execution_and_exit.structural_stop: Exit if signed ETH return from entry is <= -max(10bp, 0.75 times the fixed beta-implied residual gap at entry).
execution_and_exit.unresolved_day_boundary: A position still open at source end is a failed/incomplete path and cannot promote; it is not silently closed at a favorable price.

information_contract.decision: Only after the full leader horizon and contemporaneous follower horizon have completed.
information_contract.entry: First actual ETHUSDT public trade at or after decision timestamp plus 100ms.
information_contract.missing_data: No time compression, no interpolation across stale price state, and no favorable fill assumption.
information_contract.price_state: Last observed public trade price may be carried causally for features only when age is at most 2000ms; entries and exits require an actual trade.
information_contract.rolling_features: All volatility, activity baselines and BTC-to-ETH beta estimates end strictly before the candidate shock window.

markets.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

research_question: Can a completed Bybit BTCUSDT event-time aggressive shock predict a still-unincorporated ETHUSDT response strongly enough to survive explicit latency and 12/18/24bp round-trip costs?
